response.justification: Bogdan is a highly experienced, versatile software engineer with a strong track record across web, mobile, and systems programming, and he has recent exposure to MCP and agentic-workflow tooling. However, the resume shows no demonstrated experience with AI/ML solution design, vector databases, RAG architectures, cloud-native AI systems, or multi-agent frameworks like LangGraph/CrewAI, and no evidence of leading technical discovery sessions with enterprise stakeholders. His skill set and career history are strongly oriented toward general full-stack and infrastructure engineering rather than applied GenAI, making him a weak match for this Staff Forward Deployed Engineer, GenAI role despite his seniority and technical breadth.
strengths: 18+ years of broad, senior-level software engineering experience across multiple domains and languages
Recent hands-on work with MCP (Model Context Protocol) and AI-agent infrastructure tooling
Strong software craftsmanship background (TDD, CI/CD, mentoring, workshops) indicating engineering leadership ability
concerns: No demonstrated experience with RAG architectures, vector databases, or LLM evaluation/optimization
No evidence of designing AI systems on major cloud platforms (AWS/GCP/Azure) or building AI-specific data pipelines
No customer-facing technical discovery or forward-deployed consulting experience with enterprise clients

key_factors.factor: No enterprise customer-facing technical discovery experience
Strong general senior/staff engineering background and MCP exposure
